program.name: Push & Pull Roulette
program.subject: Variety
program.blurb: Push one day, pull the next, never the same session twice: short and focused.
program.about: The upper body in two halves, never the same session twice. Push days deal presses, chest, shoulders, push-ups or a kettlebell press; pull days deal rows, the back, the upper back, floor pulls, a kettlebell pull or grip work; arm days fall on either side. Each comes in a different format, and the same kind never lands two days running. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Every day different · push or pull, short
